description: Core window/app permissions for vibedeck's main window. The served vibedeck app itself talks to its own Node server over plain HTTP/WebSocket, never through Tauri's IPC bridge, so beyond Tauri's own default core set the only permissions granted are Phase 11b's updater (check/download/install) and process (relaunch after an approved install) — see apps/web/src/shell/UpdateBanner.tsx for what actually calls these.
